title: Beat Timer
tagline: Easily add silence or trim the beginning of your song so it starts at the right time. 🎵
why: Mappers of rhythm games like BeatSaber would otherwise need an audio editor like Audacity or ArrowVortex just to fix where a song starts.
It runs entirely in the browser using WebAssembly ffmpeg.

sections.title: About
body: Beat Timer is mainly built to allow mappers of rhythm games like BeatSaber to easily add silence or trim audio at the beginning of their song to make it start at the right time without installing an audio editor like Audacity and ArrowVortex.

sections.title: How to use it
numbered: If you have difficulties check the help menu on top left.

sections.title: Development
numbered: Run the development server with `npm run dev`
